text.en: Handlers appreciate trainer Joseph and coordinator Kayla for their structured approach, responsive communication, and clear explanations of canine psychology. Most clients value learning practical techniques they can consistently apply at home, though one owner felt the initial onboarding process lacked formal documentation.

Multiple dog owners report outstanding results after working on challenging issues such as reactivity, leash pulling, resource guarding, and severe puppy mouthing. Clients feel far more confident walking their dogs in urban settings, although one reviewer was dissatisfied with outcomes from an overnight board and train program.

title.en: Individualized attention with mixed boarding feedback

text.en: Pet parents praise the trainers for tailoring foundation exercises to each dog's specific personality and temperament, helping rescue dogs overcome fear. However, one client reported that their dog returned from boarding training in poor physical shape and excessively thirsty, raising concerns about overnight supervision.

q.en: What behavioral issues does Marley's Misfits Dog Training focus on?

a.en: Programs address dog reactivity, severe anxiety, jumping, puppy mouthing, resource guarding, leash pulling, and off-leash recall reliability.

q.en: Do trainers provide guidance and support for owners between sessions?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that trainers respond promptly via text message with practical advice when unexpected behavioral challenges arise.

q.en: Are training methods adapted for nervous rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that trainers take time to understand a rescue dog's history and establish realistic, progressive foundation goals.

q.en: Does the facility offer private one-on-one training lessons?

a.en: Yes, the business provides personalized private sessions in addition to structured puppy programs and behavioral consultations.
